GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (26 Mar 47) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1584)
APO 500
26 March 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminals.
1. Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 11 Sep 46, file AG 000.5 (11 Sep 46) LS-R, (SCAPIN - 1194), wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one HARA, (FNU), Lt. Colonel, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said HARA's name for the reason he is presently interned and serving his sentence.
2. Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government dated 11 Sep 46, file AG 000.5 (11 Sep 46) LS-R, (SCAPIN - 1194), wherein the Imperial Japanese Government was directed to deliver one MORI, Kunizo, Vice Admiral, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest possible date, is amended to delete said MORI's name for the reason he is presently interned and serving his sentence.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
